comparison.objective: Insert a heater plug into the safe floor socket rather than an overloaded extension strip.
comparison.physical_skill: Safety-aware socket selection plus millimetre-clearance plug alignment and insertion.
comparison.success_condition: Heater is plugged into the floor socket; insertion-depth, force, and damage thresholds are not given.
comparison.reason: Precision insertion is generic overlap, but its tested outcome is safe electrical connection, not mandrel-guided impact fracture and containment of released tangs.
